[Colors] aged parchment (#E8D5AE), sepia ink (#3A2318), warm amber cocktail (#F0A33C), deep barn brown (#2A1610), muted olive garnish. [Layout] a curled scroll sheet filling the frame at a slight angle; headline top center; product name and description left; price block on a torn label; the glass as hero at lower center; castle silhouette watermark behind; address footer strip. [Typography] condensed serif caps "HAUNTED MENU" with the O as a jack-o'-lantern, a heavy serif line "Spooky Limited Drinks", small caption in a bordered box, oversized price numerals, a script signature for the date. [Subject] a stemmed coupe glass of iced orange cocktail rimmed with spice, garnished with a dried orange wheel, rosemary and a tiny white ghost pick, tied with a black ribbon; a small carved pumpkin and candle at the lower left; a gothic castle and bats faintly printed on the parchment; scattered cinnamon and sugar on a dark wood bar. [Lighting & Mood] moody bar candlelight, shallow depth of field, warm sepia grade. [Details] pricing "$29 event price, $49 for two", date range, phone and address placeholders, wax-seal style accents.

title: Molten Pumpkin Cake Halloween Poster
prompt: Professional Halloween dessert poster, vertical, assembled as a playful cut-out collage. [Colors] Lavender #C7B3E6 pale ground, white-and-lilac gingham, vivid pumpkin #E8731F, plum #6B3FA0, cream #FBF3E4 paper borders. [Layout] Collage grid: a ribbon date banner at the very top, an oversized two-line headline below it, a short caption, a paper-bordered photo of the cake filling the lower half, a burst sticker at the right, vertical micro labels flanking the photo, a lilac price tag overlapping the bottom edge. [Typography] Bubble display type with plum outline and orange fill, slightly rotated; a starburst sticker in tight condensed caps; vertical letterspaced micro type down both sides. [Subject] A glossy pumpkin-shaped cake photographed as a cut-out, one wedge sliced away so a molten orange custard core pours onto the board; a second carved-lid pumpkin behind it; a cobweb with a hanging spider in the top right; crescent moon and scattered stars. [Lighting & mood] Bright even light, sticker-shop energy, hard cut edges. [Details] Thick white paper borders with soft drop shadows, checkered runner, bunny-ear steam marks, copy: "MOLTEN PUMPKIN CAKE", "OCT 30 - NOV 1", "$9.9".

title: Neon Halloween Carnival Livestream Overlay Frame
prompt: Professional Halloween livestream overlay frame, vertical, neon glow finish. [Colors] Ember orange (#F26B0F) fading toward warm cream at the centre, with hot magenta (#FF2E8B), acid lime and pure black silhouette shapes; cyan and pink neon tube edges. [Layout] A symmetrical frame: wide glowing header lockup across the top, a left vertical rail of four round icon badges, a taller coupon stack pinned to the right side, a clear empty centre stage, and a bottom horizon of flat black silhouettes. [Typography] Extruded comic display letters with gradient fill, cream outline and glow bloom; short caps labels beneath each icon; numeral blocks on the coupons. [Subject] A carved pumpkin in a purple witch hat sits inside the headline, flanked by a small ghost and skull; along the bottom, a crooked haunted house, a bubbling cauldron and a stacked pumpkin trio; spider webs in the corners. [Lighting & mood] Blacklight halo bleed, high-energy shop-stream vibe. [Details] Rounded badge frames, coupon perforations, faint halftone. Text: "HALLOWEEN CARNIVAL", "$10 OFF", "$20 OFF".

title: Sweet Ghost Cake Halloween Sweets Event
prompt: Vertical dessert promotion poster, velvet still life photography. [Colors] deep aubergine #3A2352 rising to violet #6B4E8E, cream fondant #F4E9DC, pale lilac ribbon #B79BD6, apricot #E8A05C. [Layout] top third reserved for a stacked headline, a ghost cake on a black pedestal right of centre, a pumpkin cake front-left on a brass dish, vertical price tags beside each cake, footer band for date and address. [Typography] clean geometric sans in white, a light script for the English kicker, small numerals kept quiet against the plate. [Subject] a domed ghost cake with piped eyes, lilac bows and fondant bats, a second cake sculpted as a smiling pumpkin with a curled stem, mini ghost cookies, chocolate bat cookies, dark grapes, scattered gold star sprinkles. [Lighting & mood] soft overhead beauty light, translucent ghost silhouettes floating behind, plush and appetising. [Details] cocoa dust on crushed crumbs, glossy ganache, shallow depth of field, matte velvet surface, "SWEET GHOST CAKE", "$42", "OCT 31 - NOV 1".

title: Elegant Gothic Halloween Party Invitation
prompt: Professional Halloween party invitation, vertical, letterpress finish. [Colors] oxblood (#4A0D10), warm gold foil (#D9A857), candle cream (#F0DCB4), near-black. [Layout] a tall gold headline at the top with a small banner beneath, the clinking glasses filling the middle, a wide date line set near the bottom edge. [Typography] ornate condensed gothic caps rendered as raised gold foil with drip terminals, a small brushed-script accent, hairline letterspaced numerals. [Subject] two hands with jewelled rings crashing two pilsner glasses together, foam and beer spray suspended midair, warm candle flames and a hanging lantern behind, black roses, a small pumpkin, gift boxes and glass decanters on a dark table. [Lighting & mood] warm backlight, deep shadow, celebratory and opulent. [Details] debossed cotton-stock texture, dust motes, ribbon tails, "INVITATION", "OCT 29 - 31", "TOAST WITH US".

title: Halloween Trick or Treat Party Poster
prompt: Professional Halloween party poster, vertical, risograph print finish. [Colors] electric blue (#1B4FD8), ink black (#141414), off-white paper (#F2EFE6), tomato red (#E03B26) boots. [Layout] a headline slab across the top edge, a jagged paper burst at upper left, the hero centred on a blue disc, an oversized two-line title at the bottom over a slim info strip. [Typography] rough blocky sans with distressed edges, a hand-painted starburst label, tiny tracked footer caps. [Subject] a sheet ghost in a black pointed witch hat and chunky red platform boots, swinging a jack-o'-lantern candy pail, a floating carved pumpkin with a jagged grin beside it and a bat skimming past. [Lighting & mood] flat poster light, gritty halftone grain, loud and humorous. [Details] four-point sparkles, torn paper edges, slightly misregistered ink layers, "HALLOWEEN", "TRICK OR TREAT", "OCT 31".
